description: This is an abstract Java class named AbstractIdValidator that provides a base for validating identifiers using a regular expression. It implements the BiConsumer interface to process CharSequence IDs along with DittoHeaders, and throws runtime exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: AbstractIdValidator
classes.description: An abstract class that validates identifiers against a regex pattern, handles validation logic, and throws exceptions for invalid IDs.

methods.name: AbstractIdValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with a specific regex pattern for IDs.
